# The Cupcake Desire

> Online bakery in Narre Warren, Victoria, baking hand-frosted cupcakes, cakes, macarons and cake slices to order and delivering across Melbourne Metro. Online orders only — no walk-in store.

## Key facts

- Kitchen: 352 Princes Hwy, Narre Warren VIC 3805, Australia (online orders only, no walk-in store)
- Phone: +61 3 9705 0051
- Delivery area: Melbourne Metro
- Lead time: order before noon for next-day delivery (after 2pm); orders after noon arrive the day after next. Larger orders need 2 days' notice, cakes 3 days; weddings and corporate events typically a week.
- Free delivery on orders of $100 or more
- Dietary: eggless versions of every flavour; vegan and gluten-free ranges available
- Corporate: edible-logo cupcakes, mini cupcakes, cake slices and logo cakes for offices and events
